contract: Classify the same prefix at 32, 2048 and 65536 bytes, and at full length. The candidate reports the elementary probe's Kind or the container selected by the facade's source signature policy. The reference runs every installed demuxer probe over a zero-padded buffer without a filename.

Fold kind 3 with the verdict: 0 unrecognised or outside the selected family, 1 FLAC, 2 MPEG audio, 3 ADTS, 4 AC-3 family, 5 EBML, 6 ISO BMFF, 7 Ogg, 8 MPEG transport at either packet spacing. Only a reference score strictly above AVPROBE_SCORE_RETRY counts as a positive verdict. The combined eac3 and ac3 demuxer results share one field.

A fixed signature checks the declared prefix and ordering. A scored demuxer probe can decline the same prefix or choose a different format. The facade policy observes its selection at one accepted box set, Ogg enabled and TS188 preferred; internal Need lengths and an alternate caller's transport tie policy are outside this comparison.
